_comment: 2026-07-26 main-quest spec 4, Phase 6: THE canonical for the pilgrimage spine `where_the_door_reaches`. Two subjects, both live. (1) THE START: Pisces's new hub arm, gated door_awakened / hide_when spine_started, banks the quest + spine_started and speaks the foreshadow line -- the plan assumed door_awakened banked on a pisces_magic surface, but its real producer is sleep_beat.gd's three study sleeps (door_awakening owns that chain), so the spine starts when the player REPORTS the awakening. (2) THE RIVERFARM CAPSTONE: Eloise raising the feeding ward herself off her own craft, banking lattice_witch_lore and completing the quest's first beat -- proving the arm is REVISIT-reachable (this fixture's price_of_a_favor is already reported and closed, exactly the old-save position spec 8 requires the arm to survive). Both hubs are pinned with EXACT option arrays: the new arm's presence at the start, and its ABSENCE after the bank (the hide_when retire proof, riverfarm_talk's own idiom). The tail returns to Pisces to prove the CONTEXTUALIZING half -- his greet swaps to the witch reaction text_variant under the last-match-wins contract, and the spine option is gone. Inter-map hops use `teleport` (the door_chain_fight/arc_flow precedent): riverfarm_walkthrough and riverfarm_talk already prove the portal route and the hollow path live, and this script's subject is the spine's dialogue wiring, not pathing -- the one route leg kept live is the village->hollow crossing, mirroring riverfarm_talk's exact approach. Every teleport lands one cell short of its target followed by a `move` INTO it (sets facing even when blocked). NO combat anywhere: combat_started asserted absent whole-run.

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces

== THE RIVERFARM CAPSTONE == Eloise (5,8). Teleport to (5,9), bump up to face her; first interact = pool line, second opens riverfarm_witch.

EXACT hub pin, THE REVISIT PROOF: this save's price_of_a_favor is already REPORTED and closed (spec 8's old-save position), and the capstone arm is still the last row -- it hangs on the hub, not on a chain tail. blight_lifted hides the mediation option and reveals both commerce rows; drove_off_collectors is 0 so the craft topic shows; lattice_witch_lore is 0 so the new arm shows. Greeting is the blight_lifted variant (witch_lessons unbanked).

payload_contains.speaker: Eloise
payload_contains.text: Paid, one way or another. I don't ask which. Sit if you like, or don't — I've got stock for coin now too, if that suits you better than favors.

options.text: What's this blight really about?
What have you got, for coin instead of favors?
I've got a few things I don't need, myself. Buying?
Just tea, then.
The way you work — the craft. Could a person learn it?
You've been sniffing at me since I came in. Go on.

steps._comment: Take the capstone arm at visible index 5.
SHE raises it. The player asked her to say what she was already noticing; no component was ever requested.

payload_contains.speaker: Eloise
payload_contains.text: Your door smells of a feeding ward. I keep one myself — smaller. Sit. If you're going to live over one, you'll learn what it eats.

steps._comment: witch_ward_lore: 0 'Then I'm sitting.' banks the lattice piece (goto, NOT end -- effects apply before the advance, so the counter lands ahead of the next node).
`beat` is the COUNT of completed beats (riverfarm_talk's own pins read 1 then 2 on a two-beat quest), so the spine's first beat -- riverfarm_reach -- reports 1.
HER OWN PIECE ONLY: a hedge witch's feeding practice, scaled to her hollow. No seal, no lattice, no assembled picture.

payload_contains.speaker: Eloise
payload_contains.text: Mine takes milk and a word, every seventh night. Yours was built to hold something that argues back, and a ward like that gets fed on purpose, by someone who meant it to outlast them. Don't starve it in a hurry, child. Left hungry, it will start drawing what it needs from whatever is nearest — the heat off your hearth first, then the sleep of whoever lives over it.

steps._comment: == THE RETIRE PROOF == re-enter the same waking (pool already spent, so interact opens the conversation directly): the capstone row must be GONE, hide_when lattice_witch_lore, and the exact options array pins its absence.

payload_contains.text: Ward-lore from a hedge witch. Do not make that face — hers is older than the Guild's, and she fed hers too. The two traditions agree that a ward can be fed, and between them they have not produced a word for the practice. I shall be supplying one before the month is out.

options.text: Walk me through it again.
Never mind.
The other art. The one you actually practice. Teach me.

Teleport to the enchanter_shop landing cell (6,7) -- the open cell north of the shop door, walk up 3 / left 4, bump west-north into him; he carries a talk_pool, so two interacts (hedault_enchant_loop's own approach). His three enchant rows and the fragment row are requires.item/gold gates -- VISIBLE-LOCKED, never hidden (dialogue.gd's _progress_gated hides only accomplishment/board/delivery/once_per_waking legs), so the hub shows six rows and the new arm is the last.
#423: the teleport lands on the enchanter_shop landing cell (6,7) -- the open cell north of the shop door, NOT beside him; walk to (2,4) then bump north into (2,3).

payload_contains.speaker: Hedault
payload_contains.text: State the item and keep your hands where I can see them. First I appraise. Then I correct, if correction is warranted, and I charge exactly what the work is worth.

steps._comment: Take the capstone arm at visible index 5 (three enchant rows locked on items we do not hold, the fragment row locked the same way, 'Just looking.', then the arm).
HE raises it, off his own counter work -- the player asked what he was staring at, not for a component.

payload_contains.speaker: Hedault
payload_contains.text: Hold still. There is a residue on your sleeve I do not see twice in a decade. Ruin warding. A set ward would have gone quiet years ago; this one is fed, and the draw is live. Looking costs nothing.

steps._comment: door_reading: 0 'Go on, then.' banks the piece.
HIS OWN PIECE ONLY: an enchanter's set-versus-fed read, stopping exactly where fragment_study stops ('I will not guess at names in a shop').

payload_contains.speaker: Hedault
payload_contains.text: A set ward holds a shape. A fed ward has to be sourced, continuously, from somewhere with capacity. Whoever hung that frame did not hang it alone, and I have measured what it pulls. Nothing in your pantry pulls that. I will not speculate further in a shop. Bring me the setting when you know, and I will price the work correctly.

steps._comment: Pisces again: the greet must ADVANCE to the Hedault variant -- last-match-wins puts it below the witch line, so the most recent discovery is the one he opens with. The ascending-variants contract, proven by walking it rather than by reading the file.

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: Hedault read your frame unbidden and charged you nothing, and from that man a waived fee is appetite. I know the feeling. He is better at settings than I will ever be. I am still deciding what to do with knowing it.

steps._comment: == THE PALLASS CAPSTONE == Grimalkin (pallass_market 18,3), the office's measuring mind rather than the clerk who says he only handles paper. Teleport to (18,5), step up to (18,4), then a blocked bump into his own cell to face up without moving (grimalkin_study_loop's idiom). No talk_pool on him -- one interact opens the conversation.

EXACT hub pin: the exam row is hide_when grimalkin_examination_passed (already passed here), the turn-in row needs board_accepted true (no posting held), so the visible list is studies / passing through / the new arm. Base greeting -- neither study bounty is completed in this fixture.

payload_contains.speaker: Grimalkin
payload_contains.text: Stand up straight when you address me. I measure everything that comes through this office, and most of it is found wanting. State your business.

options.text: About the studies.
Just passing through.
You've been about to say something since the stamp.

steps._comment: Take the capstone arm at visible index 2. It carries chatted_with_grimalkin like every other option on this hub (d1 #247), which this run banks for the first time.
HE raises it, out of the forge tier's own maintenance practice.

payload_contains.speaker: Grimalkin
payload_contains.text: I have. The forge tier runs on rune-fed work. Every ward up there eats on a schedule a smith keeps in a ledger. Two feedings a shift, logged. No smith keeps one for your door. Stand still.

steps._comment: forge_runes: 0 'What does that cost me?' banks the last piece.
HIS OWN PIECE ONLY: rune-feeding as forge maintenance plus his standing objection to anything unmeasured. He does not know what sits at the far end of the draw and says so.

payload_contains.speaker: Grimalkin
payload_contains.text: It costs whatever it is drawing on, and it has been drawing unsupervised since long before you owned it. I do not find that alarming. I find it unmeasured. Find what sits at the far end of the draw and bring me the numbers. I will publish them and you will be a footnote.

steps._comment: == THE THIRD REACTION == the greet advances one last time, to the forge line. Three pieces collected, three reactions walked, and he has still never assembled them -- that is Act V's job (Phase 7).

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: A Drake forge taught you in an afternoon what my tuition has been circling for a month. They feed their runes. Feed them, on a schedule. Maintenance, they call it. I am revising my rates. Downward. The new schedule is chalked on my slate already.
